blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte said Monday that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. had effectively admitted to considering her a threat to the country since 2023, following his recent remarks on alleged Chinese funding linked to her husband’s firm. During a working visit to Singapore on Sunday, Marcos warned that allegations of Chinese entities funding a Philippine firm linked to Duterte’s husband, lawyer Mans Carpio, could pose a threat “at the highest level” to the country if proven true.
